services.name: Campsite
services.desc: The BLR Campground is a privately owned lakeside campground, residing on Crown land in the foothills of central Alberta. We do not offer weekend camping, as all campsites are leased on a yearly basis. This provides a campground community of folks who look out for each other, invest in the community & the resort, and look forward to seeing each other throughout the camping season. The campground is almost entirely off-grid, providing an opportunity to unplug from the world and reconnect with yourself, family & nature.
